domain_label: Intent Elicitation, Clarifying Questions & Pragmatics (LLM Engineering subdomain)
assumptions: no observed dataset or benchmark evidence supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
subdomain scope is the front-end intent-elicitation layer: ambiguity detection, clarifying questions, pragmatics, multilingual handling, and downstream handoff
target system is a multi-turn orchestrated LLM front-end that understands intent first then passes to specialist
user population includes Hindi/Punjabi/Hinglish code-switched speakers as a primary segment
exclusions: fine-tuning of intent classification models (covered in ftune subdomain)
cross-session persistent memory and long-term user profiles

competency_questions.question: How is user intent taxonomy defined and what ambiguity types does the system recognize?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: AMBIG_DETECT and INTENT_SCHEMA define taxonomy and ambiguity classes

competency_questions.question: How are clarifying questions generated and ranked for informativeness?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: QUESTION_GEN + INFO_GAIN define generation and ranking

competency_questions.question: How does the system detect out-of-domain or out-of-scope intents?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SCOPE_BOUND defines OOD detection and routing

competency_questions.question: What is the stopping rule for clarifying questions and how does stake level influence it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: STOP_RULE defines turn budget and stake override

competency_questions.question: How is intent confidence calibrated to true probabilities?
How is a Bayesian intent prior maintained and updated from traffic?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PRIOR_UPDATE defines prior initialization and update

competency_questions.question: How is dialogue context tracked across turns and coreferences resolved?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CONTEXT_TRACK defines belief state and coreference handling

competency_questions.question: How are user answers to clarifying questions parsed and integrated into the belief state?
How does the system adapt question style to user persona and language register?
How does the system handle Hindi/Punjabi/Hinglish code-switched utterances?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MULTILINGUAL defines script detection, normalization, cross-lingual mapping

competency_questions.question: How is Gricean pragmatics and implicature applied to infer intent beyond literal text?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PRAG_IMPLICATURE defines speech-act and implicature inference

competency_questions.question: How is intent elicitation quality measured end-to-end?
How does the explicit quality/cost/speed dial parameterize downstream orchestration?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: OBJ_DIAL defines QCS elicitation and handoff parameterization

competency_questions.question: How is the final resolved intent handed off to the specialist orchestrator?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: HANDOFF defines envelope schema and escalation path

glossary.definition: the user's goal or task as inferred from utterance and context
a named attribute-value pair extracted from user utterance needed to execute the intent
condition where a single utterance is consistent with multiple distinct interpretations
a system-generated follow-up question to resolve ambiguity in user intent
expected reduction in entropy of the intent posterior from observing the answer to a question
what a speaker implies beyond the literal content of an utterance, derivable from Gricean maxims
mixing of two or more languages within a single utterance, e.g. Hindi-English (Hinglish)
the system's probability distribution over possible interpretations of the user's intent and slots at each dialogue turn
explicit user preference encoding quality, cost, and speed priorities as a weight vector for orchestration
out-of-domain or out-of-scope: user intent that falls outside the system's defined task boundary

source_registry.description: heuristic prior estimates for intent elicitation, clarifying questions, and pragmatics work units in absence of supplied datasets
Levinson, S.C. (1983). Pragmatics. Cambridge University Press. Foundation for Gricean maxims and speech-act theory.
Jurafsky & Martin, Speech and Language Processing (3rd ed.), Chapter 24-26: Dialogue Systems and Chatbots.
grounding_limits: textbook treatment; specific benchmarks evolve faster than text

source_registry.description: Aliannejadi et al. (2019). Asking Clarifying Questions in Open-Domain Information-Seeking Conversations. SIGIR 2019.
grounding_limits: open-domain IR focus; task-oriented dialogue differs

nodes.definition: Classify incoming user utterances by ambiguity type (lexical, syntactic, referential, scope, pragmatic) to decide whether and what to ask.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new user population introduces unseen query patterns

pros.claim: Correct ambiguity taxonomy gates all downstream clarification logic
pros.example: pragmatic vs lexical ambiguity trigger different question templates

cons.claim: Wrong taxonomy label silently routes request through wrong clarification branch
cons.example: referential ambiguity classified as scope ambiguity yields irrelevant follow-up

failure_modes: over-triggering on low-stakes ambiguity
conflating lexical and pragmatic ambiguity
acceptance_tests: ambiguity taxonomy enumerated with mutually exclusive definitions
detector F1>0.75 on held-out intent test set
revisit_triggers: new query type observed outside existing taxonomy
precision drops below 0.70 on ambiguity detection

nodes.definition: Define when to ask a clarifying question: the decision rule balancing information gain against user friction, driven by ambiguity confidence and task stakes.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user friction metrics shift or stake taxonomy changes

pros.claim: Explicit policy prevents ad-hoc per-engineer ask decisions
pros.example: stake-based override ensures high-risk tasks always confirm

cons.claim: Over-conservative policy annoys users; under-conservative leads to wrong outputs
cons.example: asking for clarification on every query doubles round-trips

failure_modes: always asking regardless of confidence
ignoring stake level in decision
acceptance_tests: policy documented with thresholds per stake tier
shadow-mode run shows ask-rate within target band
revisit_triggers: user complaint rate on excess questioning rises
task error rate rises on direct-proceed decisions

nodes.definition: Quantify expected reduction in intent uncertainty from asking each candidate clarifying question, selecting highest-gain question within friction budget.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: intent distribution shifts in production traffic

pros.claim: Maximally informative questions resolve ambiguity in fewest turns
pros.example: single yes/no question splits binary intent uncertainty in half

cons.claim: IG computation requires calibrated intent prior; miscalibration leads to suboptimal picks
cons.example: uniform prior treats all intents as equally likely causing low-utility questions

failure_modes: uncalibrated prior flattens IG scores
ignoring question cost/length in selection
acceptance_tests: IG ranking matches human-judged ordering on benchmark set
revisit_triggers: new intent class added to model

nodes.definition: Determine when to stop asking follow-up questions: confidence threshold, max-turn budget, or diminishing IG criterion.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: downstream task error rate changes after stopping decisions

pros.claim: Hard turn-budget prevents runaway question loops
pros.example: max 2 questions before proceeding with best-effort intent

cons.claim: Fixed threshold may stop too early on high-stakes ambiguous queries
cons.example: confidence threshold 0.85 inadequate when task irreversibility is high

failure_modes: ignoring stake level in stop criterion
conflating confidence with correctness
acceptance_tests: system stops after configured max turns in test harness
stake-override tested for high-irreversibility tasks
revisit_triggers: downstream error rate rises after stopping

nodes.definition: Apply Gricean maxims and speech-act theory to infer implied user intent beyond literal utterance content.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user population or communication style shifts

pros.claim: Captures indirect requests that literal NLU misses entirely
pros.example: 'can you open the window?' interpreted as request not capability question

cons.claim: Pragmatic inference is context-heavy and brittle across cultures
cons.example: Gricean implicature patterns differ in high-context vs low-context cultures

failure_modes: over-applying implicature to literal questions
ignoring prosodic/emoji context
acceptance_tests: speech-act labels match annotation on held-out pragmatics benchmark
revisit_triggers: new conversation style or cultural user group onboarded

nodes.definition: Handle intent elicitation for Hindi/Punjabi/Hinglish code-switched utterances: transliteration normalization, script detection, cross-lingual intent mapping.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new language variant or script added to user base

pros.claim: Unlocks correct intent classification for a dominant user segment
pros.example: Hinglish 'mujhe ek PDF chahiye' correctly maps to PDF-generation intent

cons.claim: Transliteration normalization has high error rate on arbitrary Romanization
cons.example: same word romanized 5 different ways in user corpus

failure_modes: script-detection error flips Devanagari to Latin pipeline
intent mapped via English translation loses cultural nuance
acceptance_tests: script detection accuracy >0.95 on mixed-script test set
intent F1 on Hinglish >0.72
revisit_triggers: new regional language or script introduced

nodes.definition: Elicit and encode user's explicit quality/cost/speed priority to parameterize downstream orchestration and model selection.

included: quality vs cost vs speed tradeoff elicitation

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: orchestration cost model or model tier changes

pros.claim: Explicit objective dial aligns system behavior to stated user priority
pros.example: cost-first dial selects cheaper model tier; speed-first dial disables multi-step reasoning

cons.claim: Users may not know their true preference until after seeing output quality
cons.example: user selects 'fast' then complains about quality

failure_modes: treating QCS as fixed instead of session-updatable
ignoring task-specific overrides
acceptance_tests: QCS dial exposed in API and maps to documented orchestration branches
default tested
revisit_triggers: user satisfaction splits by dial setting

nodes.definition: Extract structured (intent-class, slot-key-value) tuples from user utterances using a task-oriented NLU model.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: domain ontology or task inventory changes

pros.claim: Structured output enables deterministic downstream routing
pros.example: intent=book_flight + slots={origin,dest} routes directly to booking agent

cons.claim: Fixed slot schema fails on novel or compound tasks outside ontology
cons.example: 'summarize and translate this PDF' spans two intents with no compound schema

failure_modes: slot schema too narrow for real user requests
multi-intent ignored
acceptance_tests: intent F1>0.80 on in-domain test set
slot extraction EM>0.70

nodes.definition: Maintain and update belief state over dialogue turns: coreference resolution, entity tracking, and prior-slot carryover.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: session length distribution or coreference patterns change

pros.claim: Context tracking avoids re-asking for already-provided slot values
pros.example: user says 'same destination as before'; system resolves without re-asking

cons.claim: Stale belief state from earlier turn causes wrong slot carryover
cons.example: old date slot carried to new unrelated booking request

failure_modes: stale slot carryover across task boundaries
coreference error propagates to wrong entity
acceptance_tests: belief state accuracy >0.80 on multi-turn test cases
coreference resolved on 3+ turn chain

nodes.definition: Package final resolved intent, slot dict, QCS params, and confidence into a canonical handoff envelope passed to specialist orchestrator.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: downstream specialist API or slot schema changes

pros.claim: Canonical envelope decouples intent front-end from specialist back-ends
pros.example: adding new specialist requires no change to elicitation layer

cons.claim: Schema versioning friction when slot taxonomy evolves
cons.example: new slot key breaks downstream specialist expecting old schema

failure_modes: unresolved intent handed off without escalation flag
schema version mismatch silently drops slots
acceptance_tests: handoff envelope validates against JSON Schema
escalation flag set when confidence<threshold

nodes.definition: Calibrate model-reported intent confidence scores to true probabilities using temperature scaling or Platt scaling on held-out data.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: intent model retrained or deployment domain changes

pros.claim: Calibrated confidence makes stop/ask thresholds statistically interpretable
pros.example: ECE<0.05 ensures 80% confidence truly correct 80% of time

cons.claim: Calibration set must match deployment distribution; domain shift recalibrates
cons.example: news-domain calibration invalid on legal queries

failure_modes: calibrating on training set instead of held-out
temperature scalar applied without cross-validation
acceptance_tests: ECE reported on held-out set
calibration plot shows diagonal alignment

nodes.definition: Capture explicit corrections (user revises interpreted intent) and implicit signals (abandonment, re-query) to update intent model and policy.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user behavior patterns or product changes affect implicit signal validity

pros.claim: Closes the intent loop making system improve on real user behavior
pros.example: abandonment signal flags intents consistently misclassified

cons.claim: Noisy implicit signals require debiasing before use in training
cons.example: abandonment has many causes beyond wrong intent classification

failure_modes: conflating abandonment with unhelpfulness other than intent error
feedback loop causes oscillation in high-traffic intents
acceptance_tests: correction events captured in audit log
re-query rate shown in dashboard

nodes.definition: Measure end-to-end elicitation quality: intent accuracy, slot EM, clarification efficiency (turns-to-resolve), user satisfaction, and task success rate.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: task taxonomy or success criteria change

pros.claim: Multi-metric eval catches tradeoffs invisible in single metric
pros.example: high intent accuracy with high turns-to-resolve signals over-questioning

cons.claim: Task success rate hard to label automatically
cons.example: requires human annotation or proxy task completion signal

failure_modes: optimizing intent accuracy while ignoring turns-to-resolve
using training-domain eval set for production monitoring
acceptance_tests: eval pipeline runs nightly on held-out set
regression alert on metric drop >2%
revisit_triggers: new task type added to scope

nodes.definition: Generate fluent, concise, unambiguous clarifying questions ranked by information gain and adapted to user language register.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user population register or question template library updated

pros.claim: Fluent register-adapted questions improve user response rate and quality
pros.example: informal register 'what kind of doc?' vs formal 'please specify document category'

cons.claim: Neural generation may hallucinate plausible-but-misleading question options
cons.example: question implies false binary when multiple options exist

failure_modes: generating leading questions that bias user answer
question too long causing abandonment
acceptance_tests: question clarity rated >4/5 by human evaluators on sample
no leading questions in audit

nodes.definition: Parse user answers to clarifying questions into slot-value updates and integrate them into the running belief state and intent estimate.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: answer expression patterns shift in user base

pros.claim: Correct answer integration avoids re-asking already-answered slot
pros.example: user said 'in Spanish' so language slot filled and not re-queried

cons.claim: Partial or evasive answers leave slots ambiguous requiring fallback policy
cons.example: user says 'I dont know' to format question

failure_modes: failing to detect negative/evasive answer
overwriting correct slot with ambiguous answer
acceptance_tests: belief state correct after full multi-turn test sequence
evasive answer detected and flagged
revisit_triggers: user correction event after answer integration

nodes.definition: Detect when user intent falls outside system scope and route to appropriate refusal, redirection, or OOD escalation path.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: domain scope or refusal policy changes

pros.claim: OOD detection prevents system from confidently executing wrong or harmful tasks
pros.example: medical diagnosis request routed to disclaimer not attempted execution

cons.claim: Over-aggressive OOD detection refuses legitimate near-boundary requests
cons.example: legal summary request falsely flagged as out-of-scope

failure_modes: high false-positive OOD blocks valid intents
silent OOD — system proceeds with low-confidence intent
acceptance_tests: OOD benchmark precision>0.85 and recall>0.80
graceful refusal message tested per domain
revisit_triggers: new task type added to in-domain ontology

nodes.definition: Define per-turn latency SLO for elicitation pipeline components and enforce it via timeouts and circuit-breakers.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: traffic volume or infrastructure topology changes

pros.claim: Enforced latency budget prevents slow clarification from degrading UX
pros.example: 200ms SLO per turn enforced; circuit-breaker falls back to best-effort intent

cons.claim: Tight SLO forces degraded quality models under load
cons.example: context-tracking skipped at high QPS causing coreference errors

failure_modes: no circuit-breaker causes timeout cascade
SLO set without p99 measurement
acceptance_tests: p99 latency meets SLO in load test
fallback activates on component timeout
revisit_triggers: p99 latency breaches SLO in prod

nodes.definition: Adapt clarifying question style and vocabulary to user persona signals (expert vs novice, formal vs informal, Hindi-dominant vs English-dominant).

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user persona distribution or language register norms change

pros.claim: Register-matched questions yield higher-quality user answers
pros.example: novice user gets plain-English choices; expert gets technical field names

cons.claim: Persona misclassification causes condescending or confusing question style
cons.example: expert classified as novice receives oversimplified binary choice

failure_modes: persona flip mid-session causing inconsistent style
language register detector confused by code-switching
acceptance_tests: register adaptation tested across 3 persona stubs
Hindi-dominant user receives Hindi-script option

nodes.definition: Maintain and update a Bayesian prior over intent classes using session context, user history signals, and population-level traffic patterns.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: intent traffic distribution changes or new high-stake intent added

pros.claim: Informed prior reduces average turns-to-resolve on common intents
pros.example: high base-rate 'summarize' intent sets strong prior reducing questioning

cons.claim: Strong prior suppresses clarification on rare but high-stake intents
cons.example: payment reversal intent suppressed by low prior causing wrong execution

failure_modes: prior collapse to single dominant intent
stale prior from old traffic distribution
acceptance_tests: prior update tested on distribution shift simulation
rare high-stake intent not suppressed by prior

nodes.definition: Govern the canonical intent ontology: define, version, deprecate intents and slots, enforce naming conventions, and manage migrations.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: product task scope changes or downstream consumer list changes

pros.claim: Versioned schema prevents silent breaking changes in downstream consumers
pros.example: v2 schema adds required slot; consumers receive migration guide not silent breakage

cons.claim: Governance process slows iteration on fast-moving product
cons.example: new intent needs schema approval cycle before model can be trained

failure_modes: schema updated without version bump
intent deprecated without deprecation warning
acceptance_tests: schema changes require changelog entry
downstream consumers notified on breaking change
revisit_triggers: product adds significant new task category

edges.resolution_rule: stake-based override: if risk_if_wrong>0.80 extend turn budget; else apply friction budget
latency-first: if p99>SLO skip IG computation and use top-prior intent
language-first: detect script and language before applying pragmatic inference
quality-dial overrides max-turn budget: if dial=quality allow +1 turn
detection-first: run ambiguity detection before conditioning on prior to avoid prior suppression of rare intents
OOD-first: if scope_bound flags OOD, skip clarification and escalate immediately

conflict_axes.label: User Friction vs Ambiguity Resolution
conflict_axes.description: More clarifying questions reduce ambiguity but increase user friction and abandonment risk
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: use stake-level to set friction budget; default max 2 turns

conflict_axes.label: Latency SLO vs Clarification Quality
conflict_axes.description: Tight per-turn latency SLO forces lower-quality or skipped IG computation
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: latency-first in real-time UX; async IG for batch pipelines

conflict_axes.label: Prior Strength vs Rare Intent Detection
conflict_axes.description: Strong traffic-derived prior suppresses clarification on infrequent but high-stake intents
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: stake-override: high-risk intents bypass prior suppression

conflict_axes.label: Pragmatic Inference vs Literal Safety
conflict_axes.description: Aggressive implicature inference may misinterpret literal safety-critical requests
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: safety-first: literal interpretation used for flagged safety domains

conflict_axes.label: Multilingual Coverage vs NLU Accuracy
conflict_axes.description: Expanding to more language variants lowers average NLU accuracy per language
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: tier languages by user volume; maintain accuracy SLO per tier

conflict_axes.label: Schema Stability vs Product Velocity
conflict_axes.description: Strict schema governance slows new intent addition needed for fast product iteration
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: fast-track review for additive changes; breaking changes require full approval

conflict_axes.label: Quality Dial vs Cost Constraints
conflict_axes.description: User-selected quality-first dial conflicts with compute cost budget
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: hard cost cap overrides quality dial; inform user of degradation

conflict_axes.label: Persona Adaptation vs Privacy
conflict_axes.description: Inferring user persona from utterance history may conflict with data minimization principles
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: use session-only signals; no cross-session persona inference without consent

conflict_axes.label: OOD Detection Sensitivity vs Coverage
conflict_axes.description: High OOD recall refuses too many legitimate near-boundary requests
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: tune OOD threshold with held-out near-boundary test cases; prefer precision

conflict_axes.label: Feedback Loop Speed vs Signal Noise
conflict_axes.description: Fast online updates from noisy implicit signals cause policy oscillation
conflict_axes.resolution_heuristic: batch-update policy weekly; use explicit corrections for faster signal

edge_cases.label: Empty Utterance
edge_cases.description: User submits blank or whitespace-only input
edge_cases.recommended_handling: return clarifying prompt asking for intent; do not classify

edge_cases.label: Maximum Turn Budget Exhausted with Low Confidence
edge_cases.description: System reaches turn limit but intent confidence still below threshold
edge_cases.recommended_handling: hand off with low-confidence flag and escalation path to human review

edge_cases.label: Contradictory Answers Across Turns
edge_cases.description: User provides slot values in later turns that contradict earlier answers
edge_cases.recommended_handling: surface contradiction explicitly; ask user to confirm correct value

edge_cases.label: Purely Code-Switched with No Dominant Language
edge_cases.description: Utterance is ~50/50 Hindi-English with ambiguous script
edge_cases.recommended_handling: generate clarifying question in both scripts; pick user's response language for continuation

edge_cases.label: High-Stakes OOD Request
edge_cases.description: User requests something dangerous or outside scope with high confidence
edge_cases.recommended_handling: escalate immediately with structured refusal; do not attempt clarification

edge_cases.label: User Refuses to Answer Clarifying Question
edge_cases.description: User explicitly declines to provide requested slot value
edge_cases.recommended_handling: mark slot as intentionally missing; proceed with partial intent and best-effort execution

edge_cases.label: Implicature Inference Reversed by Literal Follow-Up
edge_cases.description: System infers indirect request; user's next utterance shows literal interpretation was correct
edge_cases.recommended_handling: update belief state to literal interpretation; do not re-apply implicature

edge_cases.label: QCS Dial Conflict with Task Constraints
edge_cases.description: User selects speed-first but task has mandatory quality gate
edge_cases.recommended_handling: notify user of constraint; downgrade speed dial to comply with quality gate

edge_cases.label: Schema Migration Mid-Session
edge_cases.description: Intent schema updated while active sessions reference old schema
edge_cases.recommended_handling: maintain schema version in session state; drain active sessions before schema cutover

edge_cases.label: Calibration Drift After Model Update
edge_cases.description: Intent model updated invalidating previous calibration scaling factors
edge_cases.recommended_handling: re-run calibration on held-out set immediately after model update; block deployment until ECE meets threshold

edge_cases.label: Persona Flip Within Session
edge_cases.description: User switches language register mid-session (e.g. formal to informal)
edge_cases.recommended_handling: update persona estimate per-turn with decay; do not lock persona from first turn

edge_cases.label: Zero-IG Question Set
edge_cases.description: All candidate clarifying questions yield near-zero information gain
edge_cases.recommended_handling: trigger immediate stop; hand off with current best-effort intent estimate

workflow.action: Receive raw user utterance and session context
workflow.produces: input bundle (utterance, turn history, session metadata)

workflow.action: Run script detection and language identification for multilingual routing
workflow.produces: language tag and normalized unicode form

workflow.action: Classify ambiguity type and check OOD boundary
workflow.produces: ambiguity type label and OOD flag
workflow.exit_condition: ambiguity label and OOD flag set

workflow.action: If OOD flagged: escalate with structured refusal; else continue
Extract intent and slots from utterance using task-oriented NLU
workflow.produces: intent label, slot dict, raw confidence scores

workflow.action: Update belief state with new intent and slots; resolve coreferences
Apply calibration and update Bayesian intent prior
Apply clarifying question policy: check if confidence meets threshold and turn budget
If ask: compute information gain per candidate question, select top question, adapt to persona, generate
Parse user answer, integrate into belief state, go to step 7
workflow.exit_condition: belief state updated; loop to step 7

workflow.action: If proceed: elicit QCS dial if not set; assemble handoff envelope
workflow.produces: handoff envelope JSON with intent, slots, QCS, confidence, escalation flag
workflow.entry_condition: proceed decision or max turns reached

workflow.action: Evaluate elicitation quality; log correction and feedback signals

dominance_rules.label: OOD-before-Clarify
dominance_rules.action: escalate immediately; skip all clarification steps
dominance_rules.rationale: no amount of clarification rescues an out-of-scope intent

dominance_rules.label: Stake-Override-Stop-Rule
dominance_rules.condition: task risk_if_wrong > 0.80 AND current intent confidence < 0.90
dominance_rules.action: extend turn budget by +1 regardless of friction budget

dominance_rules.label: Latency-SLO-Wins
dominance_rules.action: skip IG computation; use top-prior intent; degrade gracefully
dominance_rules.rationale: user-facing latency SLO is non-negotiable in real-time product

dominance_rules.label: Calibration-Before-Threshold
dominance_rules.condition: model updated since last calibration run
dominance_rules.action: block intent confidence thresholds from production until re-calibrated
dominance_rules.rationale: uncalibrated confidence scores make all threshold-based decisions unreliable

dominance_rules.label: Language-Before-Pragmatics
dominance_rules.condition: script detection returns non-English with confidence > 0.80
dominance_rules.action: route to multilingual pipeline before applying pragmatic inference
dominance_rules.rationale: pragmatic inference trained on English data is unreliable on code-switched input

dominance_rules.label: Schema-Version-Lock
dominance_rules.condition: handoff schema version mismatches downstream consumer
dominance_rules.action: reject handoff; return schema error to orchestrator
dominance_rules.rationale: silent schema mismatch causes downstream data corruption

dominance_rules.label: Explicit-Correction-Trumps-Prior
dominance_rules.condition: user explicitly corrects a previously classified slot or intent
dominance_rules.action: override belief state with corrected value; reset confidence to 1.0 for that slot
dominance_rules.rationale: explicit correction is ground truth and must dominate any prior

dominance_rules.label: Cost-Cap-Overrides-Quality-Dial
dominance_rules.condition: projected compute cost for quality-first execution exceeds hard cost cap
dominance_rules.action: downgrade to cost-tier model; notify user of quality degradation
dominance_rules.rationale: hard cost constraints are non-negotiable; quality dial is a preference not a guarantee

dominance_rules.label: Privacy-Limits-Persona
dominance_rules.condition: session-only persona signals requested but cross-session data required
dominance_rules.action: use session-only signals; do not access cross-session history
dominance_rules.rationale: data minimization requirement overrides personalization benefit

dominance_rules.label: Zero-IG-Triggers-Stop
dominance_rules.condition: all candidate questions yield expected IG < 0.02
dominance_rules.action: stop questioning immediately; proceed with best-effort intent
dominance_rules.rationale: questions with near-zero IG add friction without resolving ambiguity

anti_rework_rules.label: Freeze Ambiguity Taxonomy Before Training
anti_rework_rules.description: Do not change the ambiguity type taxonomy after intent model training has begun; taxonomy changes invalidate all NLU training labels

anti_rework_rules.label: Define Slot Schema Before Question Templates
anti_rework_rules.description: Clarifying question templates depend on slot names; slot schema changes force question template regeneration

anti_rework_rules.label: Calibrate After Each Model Update
anti_rework_rules.description: Skipping calibration after model update requires later emergency recalibration under production pressure

anti_rework_rules.label: Establish OOD Boundaries Before Elicitation Policy
anti_rework_rules.description: CQ_POLICY assumes a fixed OOD boundary; retroactive OOD expansion requires policy re-evaluation

anti_rework_rules.label: Validate Handoff Schema With All Consumers Before Launch
anti_rework_rules.description: Post-launch schema changes break consumers and require coordinated rollbacks

anti_rework_rules.label: Set QCS Dial API Before Building Orchestration Branches
anti_rework_rules.description: Orchestration branches are built around QCS parameter space; changing dial semantics post-build breaks all branches

anti_rework_rules.label: Multilingual Normalization Before Embedding Training
anti_rework_rules.description: Transliteration normalization must be finalized before embeddings are trained; norm changes invalidate embeddings

anti_rework_rules.label: Stopping Rule Validated With Stake Tiers Before Policy Deploy
anti_rework_rules.description: Deploying stopping rule without stake-level testing causes high-risk intent under-clarification in production

anti_rework_rules.label: Context Window Boundary Defined Before Belief State Design
anti_rework_rules.description: Belief state carryover window must be defined upfront; shrinking it post-design breaks coreference resolution

anti_rework_rules.label: Feedback Loop Debiasing Before Online Policy Update
anti_rework_rules.description: Applying raw implicit signals to policy causes Goodhart effects; debiasing must be in place before feedback influences policy

iteration_protocol.label: Ambiguity Taxonomy Review
iteration_protocol.trigger: new query type observed outside current taxonomy OR detection precision < 0.70
iteration_protocol.action: extend taxonomy, relabel affected training data, retrain intent model

iteration_protocol.label: Calibration Refresh
iteration_protocol.trigger: ECE > 0.08 on monitoring set OR intent model retrained
iteration_protocol.action: re-run temperature scaling on new held-out set; update threshold config

iteration_protocol.label: Clarification Policy Tuning
iteration_protocol.trigger: ask-rate outside target band OR user friction metric rises
iteration_protocol.action: adjust IG threshold and stake-tier friction budgets; shadow-run before deploy

iteration_protocol.label: Multilingual Coverage Expansion
iteration_protocol.trigger: new language variant onboarded OR F1 on existing language drops below tier SLO
iteration_protocol.action: add transliteration rules, collect labeled examples, retrain multilingual model

iteration_protocol.label: Schema Governance Cycle
iteration_protocol.trigger: new task type proposed OR breaking slot change requested
iteration_protocol.action: run schema review, version bump, notify consumers, update migration guide

iteration_protocol.label: Stopping Rule Stake Re-calibration
iteration_protocol.trigger: downstream task error rate changes after stop decisions OR new high-stake task added
iteration_protocol.action: re-evaluate stake tiers, adjust confidence thresholds, re-validate with human review

iteration_protocol.label: OOD Boundary Update
iteration_protocol.trigger: scope expanded or contracted OR false-positive OOD rate rises
iteration_protocol.action: update OOD test suite, retune threshold, re-validate with near-boundary cases

iteration_protocol.label: Feedback Loop Debiasing Review
iteration_protocol.trigger: correction rate rises above 5% OR implicit signal distribution shifts
iteration_protocol.action: audit debiasing logic, update noise model, validate on correction holdout

iteration_protocol.label: Question Generation Quality Review
iteration_protocol.trigger: question clarity rating drops below 3.5/5 OR answer quality degrades
iteration_protocol.action: audit question templates, update neural generator training, re-run persona adaptation tests

iteration_protocol.label: Latency SLO Enforcement Review
iteration_protocol.trigger: p99 breaches SLO in production OR new component added to pipeline
iteration_protocol.action: profile components, update timeout configs, test circuit-breaker activation

priority_rationale: Ambiguity detection and clarifying question policy are gating decisions for all downstream nodes. Intent slot extraction and the stopping rule directly determine handoff quality. Scope bounding prevents safety failures. Multilingual handling unlocks the primary user segment. Question generation, context tracking, and information gain complete the core elicitation loop. Calibration, pragmatics, answer parsing, and evaluation provide quality assurance. Objective dial, schema governance, prior update, and feedback loop are important but depend on the core being stable. Persona adaptation and latency budget are operational concerns addressed after core correctness is validated.

change_control.review_cadence: quarterly or on trigger from iteration_protocol
change_control.breaking_change_policy: breaking schema or taxonomy changes require 2-week consumer notification period and migration guide before deployment

evaluation_suite.description: Heuristic evaluation criteria for intent elicitation subdomain; no observed dataset
evaluation_suite.pass_criteria: all node acceptance_tests pass in shadow mode; eval_intent metric dashboard green
evaluation_suite.notes: no benchmark dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
